$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFHM (AIP France, chart dated 2017-07-20): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart for the notes, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty.

The reporting points are in French: "location" is the name printed in the French column of the chart, copied and not translated, and "purpose" is written in French; a point whose French name could not be read has no "location". Only "spoken.en" is English: the name the English phraseology says over the radio.
name: Megève

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD with special caracteristics, reserved for rated pilots: for ACFT pilots, hold mountain qualification (wheels or/and skis), or site authorization of altiport in validity.; for ULM pilots, it is strongly recommended to take mountain course organized by FFPLUM.
Unmarked telepheric cables near from entering circuit and RWY.
ACFT: Only one departure sector available.
Respect flying circuits due to the moutains and the environment.
Avoid overflying the farms downstream the mountain aerodrome 200 m from RWY.
Unusable outside RWY and PRKG platform.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.

AD à caractéristiques spéciales, réservé aux pilotes titulaires : pour les pilotes avions, soit de la qualification montagne (roues et/ou skis), soit de l'autorisation de site de l'altiport en état de validité. pour les pilotes ULM, il est fortement conseillé d'avoir suivi le cursus montagne organisé par la FFPLUM.
Présence de câbles de téléphérique non balisés à proximité des circuits d'intégration et de piste.
Une seule trouée d'envol. Circuit en vol à respecter compte tenu du relief et de l'environnement.
Éviter le survol des fermes en aval de l'altiport à 200 m de la piste.
